tweet.text:
Incorrect, the numbers add up.
 DHS’s July figure, up to 190,832 records, was a PRELIMINARY universe of CA voter-registration records that matched records of aliens in DHS holdings that were pending manual review. The approximately 20,000 referenced in @TheJusticeDept’s complaint are just the subset of records manually verified so far.  Preliminary screening and completed verification are not the same thing — there is zero discrepancy.
